idea.title: The Roof Cat
idea.setting: a town where the cats live on the roofs
idea.opener: In this town, the cats sleep on the roofs.
idea.premise: Our cat Pepper climbs onto the roof and won't come down, until a pigeon shows her the way.
idea.closer: In this town, the cats sleep on the roofs. And Pepper sleeps on mine.

lines.text: In this town, the cats sleep on the roofs.
I'm Leo, and my cat is called Pepper.
Pepper is a grey cat with white paws.
One day, the cat climbed onto the roof.
She sat on the very edge and meowed.
I waved at her from the street.
A pigeon landed next to her on the roof.
The pigeon hopped along the edge.
Pepper followed the pigeon to the ladder.
She climbed down, one paw at a time.
Pepper jumped into my arms and purred.
The pigeon flew away over the street.
In this town, the cats sleep on the roofs. And Pepper sleeps on mine.
